name: paperwork
description: An archive for business documents that never deletes: drop invoices, receipts and scans into an inbox; they are read (e-invoice XML, text, OCR in Docker), checked against their own text and arithmetic, named by one convention, filed per entity, year and direction, deduplicated and indexed into CSV. Each document gets a markdown note that opens in Obsidian, and a list of payments can be matched against the archive.
